text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup is here. Before heading to the waiting area, Admire Vega declares her upcoming victory to her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Naturally, her rivals are not to be outdone without a fight. Each of them heads to the showdown on the track, bearing their own motives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And Narita Top Road sits in the stands to watch them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If Admire Vega defeats the all-star competition gathered here from around the globe, she'll become a first-magnitude star… Let the race begin!
